htn_kidney.title: Combined podocyte, fibrotic and echocardiographic correlates of an operationally defined subclinical cardiorenal phenotype in chronic kidney disease: an exploratory study.
htn_kidney.authors: Akhmedova N, Tukhtaev D, Narziev B
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究（样本量约为 127）。核心观点：除了静息时和运动后的经胸超声心动图外，足细胞损伤（尿去氧肾上腺素）、纤维化（尿 IV 型胶原和血清半乳糖凝集素 3）、心壁应力（血清 NT-proBNP）和肾滤过/心血管风险的生物标志物 临床提示：尽管心血管并发症是慢性肾脏病（CKD）发病和死亡的最常见原因，但亚临床心肾重塑的检测仍然有限。
htn_kidney.abstract: Although cardiovascular complications are the most common cause of morbidity and mortality in chronic kidney disease (CKD), the detection of subclinical cardiorenal remodeling is still limited. This is a single-center, exploratory observational study of 127 patients with CKD of various etiologies (hypertensive nephropathy, diabetic nephropathy and chronic glomerulonephritis) and 30 healthy controls. In addition to transthoracic echocardiography at rest and after exercise, biomarkers of podocyte injury (urinary nephrin), fibrosis (urinary type IV collagen and serum galectin-3), cardiac wall stress (serum NT-proBNP) and renal filtration/cardiovascular risk integration (serum cystatin C) were a...

portal_hypertension.title: Does Hepatic Venous Pressure Gradient Underestimate Direct Portal Pressure Gradient? A Focused Meta-Analysis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Zeng Y, Shen Y, Fan X
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：PubMed 没有可用的摘要。 临床提示：肝静脉压力梯度是否低估了直接门静脉压力梯度？重点荟萃分析。

portal_hypertension.title: Feasibility and acceptability of pharmacist-led remote patient monitoring for carvedilol dose titration in clinically significant portal hypertension.
portal_hypertension.authors: Rodda S, McAinch C, Hunter J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：卡维地洛可降低代偿性肝硬化和临床显着门脉高压（CSPH）患者肝代偿失调的风险并提高生存率。 临床提示：远程患者监测 (RPM) 已在其他慢性病中显示出益处，但尚未针对 CSPH 中的卡维地洛滴定进行研究。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Carvedilol reduces the risk of hepatic decompensation and improves survival in patients with compensated cirrhosis and clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH). Remote patient monitoring (RPM) has demonstrated benefits in other chronic conditions but has yet to be investigated for carvedilol titration in CSPH. We aimed to evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of a novel pharmacist-led, technology enabled model of care called Optimising One Medication for Patients with Cirrhosis (OOMPa-C). In this prospective mixed-methods feasibility study, participants were provided with a Bluetooth-enabled blood pressure (BP) and heart rate (HR) monitor linked to a smartphone app during a hom...

portal_hypertension.title: Masked polycythemia vera presenting as non-cirrhotic portal hypertension with isolated gastric varices: a case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Jallad H, Khaled A, Qabaja H
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：骨髓增生性肿瘤 (MPN) 是非肝硬化门脉高压 (NCPH) 的一种罕见但重要的原因，可能表现为静脉曲张出血，而不是明显的血液学异常。 临床提示：当真性红细胞增多症 (PV) 被缺铁或既往静脉切开术掩盖时，尽管存在潜在的 JAK2 阳性肿瘤，但导致血红蛋白不升高，诊断可能会进一步延迟。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN) are an uncommon but important cause of non-cirrhotic portal hypertension (NCPH) and may present with variceal bleeding rather than overt hematologic abnormalities. Diagnosis may be further delayed when polycythemia vera (PV) is masked by iron deficiency or prior venesection, resulting in non-elevated hemoglobin despite an underlying JAK2-positive neoplasm. We report a rare case of isolated gastric variceal bleeding as the presenting manifestation of presinusoidal NCPH in a patient with early myelofibrosis evolving from iron-deficient PV. A 57-year-old man presented with intermittent rectal bleeding and melena. His history was notable for prior erythrocytosi...

portal_hypertension.title: Prognosis of pediatric hepatic Wilson disease with ATP7B loss of function variants.
portal_hypertension.authors: Mishra AK, Sen Sarma M, Dubey A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：计算机分析用于预测变异的致病性。 临床提示：具有功能丧失 (LOF) 的 ATP7B 变体可能具有不同的轨迹。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Genotype-phenotype correlations in Wilson disease (WD) have so far been inconclusive. ATP7B variants with loss of function (LOF) may have a different trajectory. Since genotypes in Asia differ from the West, we aimed to correlate LOF variants of ATP7B with the severity and outcome of hepatic WD. Patients with a confirmed diagnosis of WD (Leipzig criteria ≥4) were prospectively enrolled. Genetic sequencing of ATP7B mutations was assessed by Whole- exome sequencing. For patients with variants of uncertain significance, Sanger sequencing was additionally performed on their parents to identify the inherited variants. In silico analyses were used to predict the pathogenicity of variants. Mutation...
